scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.sw.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,WebWorker worker.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-strip-types --test library.test.ts scanner.test.ts catalog.test.ts worker.test.ts
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env dev
